6.title: Equipment Requirements
6.text:
It is the responsibility of the Employee to ensure equipment is safe and suitable. Where
working from an alternate location is planned or ongoing:

• Responsibility for purchasing equipment must be agreed between the Leader and
Employee, and
• Equipment must be appropriately maintained by the employee.

7.2.title: Working From Home Procedure
7.2.text:
Where the Employee is working from home:

• They must take regular breaks, including brief stretch breaks at least hourly
• They must not exceed three (3) hours of continuous work without a break, and
• They must report all incidents, near misses and hazards as per Incident, Near Miss and
Hazard Management Procedure (IMS.06.01.PRO.01)

4.2.1.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.2.1.text:
All Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Working from Home Training Module (IMS.03.22.TRN.01) annually.

4.1.1.title: Leaders
4.1.1.text:
Leaders are responsible for:
• Understanding this Procedure and related flexible working arrangements
• Ensuring Employees are aware of their obligations under this Procedure
• Assessing and approving requests to work from alternate locations in accordance with
this Procedure
• Ensuring required training is completed prior to remote work commencing
• Supporting Employees to report incidents in accordance with the Incident Reporting
Procedure, and
• Conducting periodic reviews of approved alternate work arrangements and retaining
required records.

7.1.title: Working From Home Assessment Procedure
7.1.text:
Prior to commencing work from an alternate location:

i. The Employee should complete the Working from Home Assessment Form
(IMS.03.22.FRM.01)
ii. The completed form must be submitted to the Leader for review and retention,
iii. The form shall be recorded as per Document and Records Management Procedure
(IMS.02.01.PRO.01).

4.1.title: Specific Roles and Responsibilities Related to this Procedure
4.1.text:
4.1.1. Leaders
Leaders are responsible for:
• Understanding this Procedure and related flexible working arrangements
• Ensuring Employees are aware of their obligations under this Procedure
• Assessing and approving requests to work from alternate locations in accordance with
this Procedure
• Ensuring required training is completed prior to remote work commencing
• Supporting Employees to report incidents in accordance with the Incident Reporting
Procedure, and
• Conducting periodic reviews of approved alternate work arrangements and retaining
required records.

4.2.title: Competency Requirements
4.2.text:
4.2.1. Verra Mobility Employees
All Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Working from Home Training Module (IMS.03.22.TRN.01) annually.
